title: Fusemachines Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Fusemachines Inc. (ticker: FUSE), a Nasdaq-listed emerging growth company, entered into a common stock purchase agreement (the 'Purchase Agreement') with Roth Principal Investments LLC on April 17, 2026, establishing a controlled equity facility that allows the company to sell up to $20,000,000 of common stock over 36 months through various purchase mechanisms including Market Open Purchases, Intraday Purchases, Pre-Market Purchases, and Post-Market Purchases.
key_points: Fusemachines Inc. entered into a stock purchase agreement with Roth Principal Investments LLC on April 17, 2026
Maximum commitment amount: $20,000,000 of common stock sales
Commitment period: up to 36 months following Commencement Date
Purchase price determined by volume-weighted average price minus a fixed discount
Company has sole discretion on timing and amount of sales; no obligation to sell
Threshold price of $0.50 per share required before Company can direct purchases
Market Open Purchases limited to lesser of 2,000,000 shares or 25% of daily volume
